name: arith_sum_moebius_mul_totient
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * (d.totient : ℤ) = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (2 - (p : ℤ))
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * (d.totient : ℤ) = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (2 - (p : ℤ))
informal: Σ_{d|n} μ(d)φ(d) = ∏_{p|n} (2 - p) — sum over squarefree divisors of a multiplicative function expands as ∏_{p|n}(1 + μ(p)φ(p)) = ∏(1 - (p-1)).
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d * ↑d.totient = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (2 - ↑p)
